Flash Floods Hit Jammu and Kashmir After Cloudburst

A cloudburst in the Chatroo area of Kishtwar district, Jammu and Kashmir, on Saturday triggered flash floods. The floods disrupted normal life across the Chenab Valley, leading to the closure of schools in Kishtwar, Doda, and Ramban districts. Some shops were also damaged in the affected areas.
